management: Same card rule as the desk: limit at the midpoint, stop with one tick of slip, half off at the first target, runner to the second. A bar that touches both is a loss.
searched: The pack does not split 0.90 by itself. The bucket that holds 0.90 is every card at 0.85 and above: 2,087 cards, 1,504 fills, Sep 2022 through Sep 2026. 2020 and 2021 are not on the tape. First target 31%. Direction 46.3%, which is worse than 53.6% at 0.65–0.70. Expectancy -0.15R, and -0.31R out of sample. The model's hottest decile hit the first target 61% of the time on 131 out-of-sample fills and still lost money.
note: Joint read. All five took cards at 0.90 and up, which live inside the 0.85+ book. That book does not win 65%.

people.rule: The draw. Does a 0.90 card go the card's way more often?
people.skill: No. Cards at 0.85 and above, the book that holds 0.90, went the card's way 46.3% of the time. Cards at 0.65–0.70 went 53.6%. A higher fit is a weaker draw, not a stronger one.
flaws: 0.85+ went the card's way 46.3%. 0.65–0.70 went 53.6%. Raising the floor does not aim the draw.
The tape starts September 2022. 2020 and 2021 were not invented.

people.rule: Take only 0.90 and better, and take all of them.
people.skill: 1,504 fills is not a thin sample. The first target was reached 466 times, 31%. Waiting for 0.90 did not raise it.
flaws: 1,504 fills at 0.85 and above. First target 31%. More selective was not more right.
Out of sample the same book lost 0.31R a fill.

people.rule: The number. Can the card's own probability model find a 65% pocket?
people.skill: The hottest decile, out of sample, hit the first target 61% of the time on 131 fills. That is the closest the model gets. It still is not 65%, and those fills lost 0.10R on average.
flaws: Hottest decile: 61% to the first target, 131 fills, average result negative. Not 65%, and not a ticket.
The high-fit book itself is marked negative: -0.15R, and -0.31R after 2024.

people.rule: Do not turn 0.90 into a live gate.
people.skill: The high-fit book is the one the pack marks negative. Making 0.90 the only ticket would refuse the cards that are no worse, and keep the book that loses. I will not write that gate.
flaws: 0.85+ expectancy is -0.15R and the verdict is negative. A 0.90 gate would keep the losing book.
Live cards stay on the chart. The fit is a checklist, not a win rate.

people.rule: The fill. Does a high score fill, and does the fill win?
people.skill: 72% of 0.85+ cards filled at the midpoint. Filling was not the problem. Of the fills, 31% reached the first target. I still rest the limit at the midpoint. I do not expect 65%.
flaws: Fill rate 72%. First-target rate 31%. The order is getting in. The target is what usually does not print.
2020 and 2021 are not in the file, so they were not run.
